notes: The skill provides the largest benefit for bug-fix titles: without the skill, the title starts with 'Bug:' instead of 'Fix', breaks the verb-first constraint, and runs 96+ chars over the 60-char limit.
The '## Testing Considerations' heading is consistently dropped to '## Testing' without the skill — a subtle but recurring deviation.
The Technical Notes 4-row format (Frontend/Backend/Database/Dependencies) is reliably produced with the skill but collapses into freeform bullets without it.
Saving the draft to issues/ is missed by the baseline in both evals; the skill's explicit workflow step fixes this reliably.

With-skill achieves 100% pass rate on both evals. Without-skill scores 67% on a feature request and only 29% on a bug report — showing the skill's value grows when the request deviates from a simple 'Add X' pattern.
